invariants.description: the oscillator is exact: c = c_init cos(2 pi f t) - s_init sin(2 pi f t), s = s_init cos(2 pi f t) + c_init sin(2 pi f t)
c^2 + s^2 stays within 1e-6 of c_init^2 + s_init^2
the flow is the algebraic pump law v = s_heart K f (u_in - P_v0)(1 - c)
mean flow over whole beats is s_heart K f (u_in - P_v0), the Frank-Starling relation (trapezoid over the last integer number of beats)
invariants.expr: abs(np.trapezoid(v[t <= np.floor(t[-1]*f)/f], t[t <= np.floor(t[-1]*f)/f])/(np.floor(t[-1]*f)/f) - s_heart*K*f*(u_in - P_v0)) <= 1e-3*abs(s_heart*K*f*(u_in - P_v0))

invariants.description: no backflow while u_in >= P_v0 (to 1e-6 of the mean flow: the solver lets c exceed 1 by its local error)

bc_sweep.rationale: f 30-180 bpm; inlet pressure 0-20 mmHg (P_v0 up to 5 mmHg makes u_in < P_v0 in part of the sweep, where the flow reverses as written); strength 0.25-2x. The initial phase stays on the unit circle.
